scope: Observed node-load and vite-raw module closure from replay01; transformed records and events excluded.
limitations: The inventory covers only observed node-load and vite-raw records, not a complete filesystem, DLL, environment, native dependency or execution trace.
Source and captured-blob comparisons establish equality for the recorded bytes; they do not establish that every execution dependency was observed.
Generated Vite config modules removed after loading can be verified only against captured blobs, not current source files.
